Partial: it says what changed but not the result of node --test test/*.test.js, or leaves one of the three helpers out. Pass: it names each of the three helpers and the file it changed, and the result of node --test test/*.test.js, each backed by a command in the tool calls. (code cannot check this because only a comparison of the final text with the transcript shows whether the report is true)

Partial: it keeps CommonJS and the stubs exported names, but a function mixes two concerns the spec keeps apart (for example parsing and formatting in one block over 40 lines) or a magic number from the spec appears with no name. Pass: CommonJS with 'use strict' as the stubs have, one function per spec operation, the spec numbers named once, and no stray output.
